notes: Immortal `date` emits C's `Current machine time:` line; the timestamp is normalized by the Tier-1 harness (R1/R2/R5e).
SCMD_DATE ignores date arguments; the separate uptime table row owns SCMD_UPTIME, so date boot must not alias uptime.
C-first `uptime` dispatches SCMD_UPTIME and emits the exact `Up since` line; it remains distinct from `date`'s SCMD_DATE path (R1/R2/R5e).
